purpose: DISCLOSURE: before the lock existed, one plain LightGBM baseline (all 510 features, default params) was scored on fold 0 of an earlier 5-fold split that overlaps ~20% of what is now the locked set: AUROC 0.8546. No design decision was tuned on it.

PRE-REGISTRATION (no locked access): final GENESIS = product of experts log sig(who)+log sig(when)+log sig(direct) over the 510 causal features; a further expert (Genesis Network heads, horizons) joins ONLY if adding it raises dev-CV pooled AUROC with a paired patient-bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero. Intent block and label-genesis auxiliary heads are EXCLUDED (dev-CV: +0.0002 and +0.0000 inside the product/LR). Locked comparisons: GENESIS vs shipped wearable stack (refit on dev) and vs single all-variable LightGBM. Headline metrics fixed now: standard hourly AUROC AND hour-matched AUROC.

PRE-REGISTRATION ADDENDUM (no locked access): dev-CV since the first entry: (1) regularised direct head (lr0.02/31 leaves/min800/ff0.3/l2 10) +0.0065 alone; (2) calibrated 3-seed Genesis Network passes the expert rule (+0.0025 [+0.0012,+0.0039] over the untuned product; +0.0015 over the tuned product). Design freezes as who x when x direct_slow x network_direct UNLESS the E11 round-2 direct config improves the full product with CI excluding zero. Locked baselines: tuned single LightGBM (strongest simple alternative), wearable LightGBM, shipped wearable stack refit on dev.
FINAL locked evaluation of spec genesis-1.0 (GENESIS vs tuned single LightGBM vs wearable vs shipped stack)

PRE-REGISTRATION E12, self-supervised pretraining (no locked access). Hypothesis: pretraining the Genesis Network encoder on label-free pretexts (block-masked value reconstruction with composite leak guard + world-model forecasts), then fine-tuning EXACTLY as the from-scratch network (3 seeds, 25 epochs, patience 4, plateau decay, Platt), improves sepsis prediction. Comparator = existing from-scratch OOF gn2 (no recompute). PRIMARY: dev-CV pooled AUROC of who x when x direct_slow x network(pretrained) vs the same product with network(scratch); paired patient bootstrap, 1000 draws; PASS iff 95% CI lower bound > 0. SECONDARY: network alone pretrained vs scratch; hour-matched AUROC. NON-VACUITY: held-out masked-reconstruction loss must beat BOTH trivial baselines (median, carry-forward) by the last pretraining epoch, else INCONCLUSIVE. COMPUTE RULES: Mac CPU only, no paid compute; Stage B (causal Transformer encoder) runs ONLY if the network-alone delta CI lower bound > 0; ONE locked look ONLY if PRIMARY passes.
